description:
``POST /v1/knowledge-bases/{id}/evaluate``: the search options every question runs with.

The defaults are an agent's knowledge defaults (``KnowledgeConfig``: ``mode="hybrid"``, ``k=4``), not
``KbSearchOptions``'s (``mode="vector"``), so a bare call measures what a new agent retrieves.

k.description: A question is found when a match is in the top `k`.
k.title: K

min_score.description: Drop hits whose `score` is below this (0-1).
min_score.title: Min Score

mode.description: `hybrid` (keyword matches fused with embedding similarity) or `vector`.
mode.title: Mode

rerank.description: `local` rescores the top candidates with the local cross-encoder.
rerank.title: Rerank

title: KbEvaluateIn
